hooks.command:
sh -c '[ -z "$PR_REVIEW_CHILD" ] || exit 0; [ "$PR_REVIEW" != off ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); case "$p" in *"gh pr create"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; url=$(printf "%s" "$p" | jq -r ".tool_response | tostring" | grep -oE "https://github[.]com/[^/ ]+/[^/ ]+/pull/[0-9]+" | head -1); [ -n "$url" ] || exit 0; cd "$(printf "%s" "$p" | jq -r .cwd)" || exit 0; f="$HOME/.cache/pr-review/$(printf "%s" "$url" | cut -d/ -f4-7 | tr / -).md"; mkdir -p "${f%/*}"; x=$(command -v codex || echo /Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/bin/codex); r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/REVIEW.md"; (b=$(gh pr view "$url" --json baseRefName -q .baseRefName 2>/dev/null || git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | cut -d/ -f2-); git fetch -q origin "$b" 2>/dev/null; { printf "Review pull request %s: the commits on the current branch that are not on origin/%s. Report the bugs and risks this change introduces, each with its file and line.
" "$url" "$b"; if [ -f "$r" ]; then printf "
Follow these review rules:

"; cat "$r"; fi; } | PR_REVIEW_CHILD=1 "$x" review -c "sandbox_mode="read-only"" - >"$f" 2>"${f%.md}.log"; osascript -e "display notification "Findings saved to $f" with title "Review finished"") </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &'
